t: This is St Peter and the Guardian Angels, a Catholic church in Rotherhithe. It was designed by Francis William Tasker, an English architect who lived from 1848 to 1904. He is known for Catholic churches built in England in the late nineteenth century, so this belongs to a larger body of his work. Tasker also designed St Gertrude's in Bermondsey, a short distance away. Seeing the two together gives you a sense of his approach.
